name: After citation 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: – having regard to the successive resolutions of the UN General Assembly on the necessity of ending the economic, commercial and financial embargo imposed by the United States against Cuba, first adopted in 1992 and reaffirmed annually ever since, including Resolution 79/7 of 30 October 2024, adopted with the support of an overwhelming majority of UN member states, including all EU Member States,
